m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Stop! Stop! Do you fools not see what you are up against?
Bat, Mellori, don't be stupid. Your Wizard friend is powerful, yes, but you both know they're no match for a Titan!
This is a one-way portal to the Shadow Realm. Come with us. The both of you. It's the only way to ensure that you'll survive the End Times.
I'll die a thousand deaths alongside these friends that I love before I ever go with you. Go on, leave! And never come back!
So be it. Come on, Rat!
Aww, Bat... you <ITALICS>love </ITALICS> us? That's so sweet.
Alright, alright, let's just get back to waking up the Spriritual Trees, shall we?
Spiritual Trees, listen and tune your immortal voices to me as we sing the Titanic Lullaby!
Titanic Lullaby is working! I can hear the The Storm Titan's winds... diminishing. *Yawn* This song is so... it's so... relaxing.
Fire it up, Bat! You and I are mortal enough to resist the Lullaby's power, we just have to focus!
*Awwuugaa* Yes! OK. Let's go take down the Storm Titan! But... maybe we just rest our eyes for a few- Nope, nope! C'mon, let's go!
I don't know what it is, but I've got a weird feeling about this next Grove.
I bet it's just the Lullaby having an effect on you. You and I are related to the Titans, you know.
Hmmm. Well, it does sound like the Storm Titan's strikes may already be weakening. Let's hurry and get the Spiritual Trees singing.
So, not that I'm afraid or anything, but before we dive headlong into the Storm, are we absolutely sure this is our best course of action?
Only one more group of Trees to awaken and tune. Let's hurry!
